rationale: Retain Advanced Power as an active ArcLight infrastructure portfolio company, but do not add a duplicate owner. The census name ArcLight Capital and the existing ArcLight Capital Partners owner identify the same manager. Correct the investment from the July 2025 announcement to the February 12, 2026 legal closing, link the disclosed Fund VIII vehicle, replace the stale InfraBridge seed attribution through the approved after-image, and add current company and regulatory evidence. No Advanced Power-specific ArcLight exit or pending sale was found through August 12, 2026.

identityResolution.platformBoundary: Count Advanced Power once as the U.S. power-development and asset-management platform. Do not separately count its development projects, managed assets or divested projects without independent manager-level ownership evidence.

ownershipResolution.stake: 100% of Advanced Power US Holdings, Inc. (the controlling U.S. entity); exact platform-level percentage not publicly disclosed
ownershipResolution.exitSearch: No Advanced Power-specific sale, divestiture, restructuring or ArcLight exit was found through August 12, 2026. ArcLight's April 2026 Fund VIII release continued to list Advanced Power as a backed thermal-power development team. DigitalBridge's pending acquisition of the ArcLight manager is not an Advanced Power ownership transfer.
